summary: V50.z253 Resoconto Km + NavChooser popup — full backend+frontend testing PASSED. Backend: 12/12 pytest passed (add/idempotent/seq0-return/seq99-404/unknown-route-404/no-return-400/list-by-route/month-totals/other-month-today-still-reflects/unauth-401/delete-and-404/per-user-isolation). Sub-user tenant isolation on km-log verified (created_by scoping). CLEANUP: all km-log entries created during tests were deleted (verified 0 items remaining).
action_items: None — feature fully working end-to-end. Optional: consider a lightweight web-only tap helper because Playwright page.click() does not fire onPress on React Native Pressable/TouchableOpacity in web preview (had to dispatch PointerEvent manually). Not blocking real users.
Console warnings from RN Web (shadow*, textShadow*, pointerEvents deprecated, transform-origin DOM prop, useNativeDriver missing) are pre-existing / cosmetic — no functional impact.
critical_code_review_comments: geo_km_log.kml_add: idempotency uses (created_by, route_id, seq) which correctly returns same entry on retry — good.
kml_list totals.today_km / week_km / month_km are always computed from 'today' independent of the selected month filter — matches expected behaviour and verified by tests.
NavChooser platform filter: android hides 'apple' option; on web both are shown (verified). iOS/Android native builds not tested here.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data. Created & deleted 2 km-log entries during flow tests. Also created a temporary route without return_to_origin (stored in geo_routes; harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: For future Expo/RN Web UI testing on this app: page.click() does NOT trigger onPress for Pressable/TouchableOpacity buttons rendered as <div>. Use PointerEvent dispatch: dispatch pointerdown/pointerup/click sequence with clientX/clientY at bounding box center. Similarly for TextInput, use the native HTMLInputElement value setter + dispatch 'input' event (page.fill/type may work when input has type='text' but React Native controlled components ignore the resulting change). Route computation via /api/geo/optimal-route with custom origin address takes 8–20s due to Nominatim geocoding — wait up to 70s.
